coach_briefing: The rate-and-recovery structure was largely followed: work 1–4 and 6 met their SPM targets and all recoveries were 235 s. The material execution deviation was work 5 at 19.99 SPM, below its 22–24 SPM target. Speed was highest in work 4 (3.459 m/s), fell in work 5 (2.970 m/s), and partly recovered in work 6 (3.168 m/s). A tailwind-to-5.5 m/s headwind shift coincided with the later work, but cannot establish why speed changed; the work-5 rate deviation is also relevant. Confirm band use and the context for work 5 before interpreting execution quality further.

deviations.description: The fifth work interval averaged 19.99 SPM, below the prescribed 22–24 SPM range for the final block.

limitations: Time alignment supports association only; it does not establish wind as the cause, nor establish athlete improvement or regression. Work 5 also had a below-target stroke rate.
environment_assessment.summary: Effective headwind shifted from -1.0 m/s (tailwind) at the session start to +5.5 m/s (headwind), crossing zero at 1800 s. This overlaps the latter portion of work 4 and the subsequent slower work 5–6 intervals, supporting an environmental association with the observed speed reduction.
